title: Dev / BYODA v1.9 : Calibration in BYODA give double readings in AAPS
symptom: After upgrading to BYODA v1.9, calibrating in BYODA sometimes results in duplicate BG readings in AAPS, causing a red triangle alert. Deleting the duplicate readings resolves the red triangle.
cause: The issue appears to be time-related to the last BG reading, as calibrating at certain times after the last reading produces duplicates while others do not. The exact root cause is not definitively identified.
fix: Deleting the duplicate readings cancels the red triangle. No permanent fix is provided in the thread.
evidence_quote: Deleting of the readings cancelled the red triangle
